TuinBooks v60.4.7 — Demo Billing Profile repair

PURPOSE
Stops the recurring red:
"browser-only Billing Profile ID was still present"
client/setup save error caused by stale local-profile-* IDs inside nested
client/service-site browser payloads.

IMPORTANT
- Front-end only.
- NO SQL.
- app.js is NOT changed.
- Frozen Schedule / Work / navigation files are NOT changed.
- Historical quote/invoice Billing Profile snapshots are NOT rewritten.

UPLOAD
In GitHub, OPEN THE EXISTING /app FOLDER FIRST.
Upload/replace ONLY these three application files:

1. index.html
2. service-worker.js
3. demo-billing-profile-repair-v6047.js   (new file)

Do NOT upload this containing folder into /app.
Do NOT upload these files at repository root.
Do NOT replace app.js.

AFTER RENDER IS LIVE
1. Open https://www.tuinbooks.garden/app/ in a private window.
2. Log into the demo account.
3. Move through Settings -> Clients -> Schedule -> Work -> Quotes -> Billing.
4. Leave the app open for at least 30 seconds so background sync runs.
5. The red browser-only Billing Profile error must not appear.
6. Edit one harmless demo client field and save it; cloud save must complete.
7. Open the field phone demo separately and confirm the existing PIN flow still works.

If the account genuinely has no server Billing Profile, the patch will not
fabricate one. It will show a normal "billing setup is still loading" message
instead of exposing the old technical local-profile error.
